svg.title: Manzil departure planning concept
svg.desc: Three Android screens for capturing journey constraints, comparing departure times, and reviewing a selected journey. All estimates are illustrative.
svg.text: A calmer way to get there.
Feature 1 · Departure planning · Native Android direction
Tell me what matters for this trip.
Tap to speak · or type instead
Actual traffic can change your arrival.
Fits your budget and walking limit.
Design concept · Illustrative estimates · No live routing
Source icons: Lucide (ISC). Original vector panda study. Screen text uses a portable preview font.
